messages.subject: unbundle() errors on Windows 7
parts:
I created a Packrat project on Ubuntu 14.04 in R 3.2.0 / Rstudio 0.98.1103.

I transferred the file to a Windows 7 computer I do not have general admin privileges on. This machine is running R 3.0.2 / Rstudio 0.98.501. I have had the same errors on a machine running R 3.1.0.

When I run packrat::unbundle(bundle = "\\\\networklocation\\pathtobundle", where = "\\\\networklocation\\folderIhavewriteaccess", restore = TRUE), I get the following errors:

- Untarring 'R_map_class-2015-05-21.tar.gz' in directory  "\\networklocation/pathtobundle"...
- Restoring project library...
Installing BH (1.55.0-3) ... Warning in utils::install.packages(pkgRecord$name, lib = lib, repos = repos,  :
  'lib = "\\networklocation/folderIhavewriteaccess/R_map_class/packrat/lib/x86_64-w64-mingw32/3.1.2"' is not writable
Error in setLibPaths(lib) : 
  No directory exists at path '\\networklocation/folderIhavewriteaccess/R_map_class/packrat/lib/x86_64-w64-mingw32/3.1.2'

Pop up asks if I want to create a library in another location. When I click yes (it defaults to a location I cannot write to), the library restore fails.

I've checked and packrat is not creating the folder "lib" within "packrat". Any thoughts? I'm trying to make this work for a class I'm teaching to avoid spending all day installing packages on machines in the computer lab.
